chapter: Haiti, Artie Shaw and Los Angeles work
title: Recording with Dinah Washington and Billy Taylor
summary: In the forties Collins recorded with Dinah Washington and Paul Quinichette and often made small-group records with Billy Taylor.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: But as I say in New York -- when I go to New York I have all of these memories, and it's just a thrill to get back there. And while living in New York I recorded with just about everybody. I recorded with Dinah Washington.

This was during -- I'd say around in the forties, when she was really doing quite a bit of recording. And let's see, who was her accompanist? I think it was Wynton Kelly was her accompanist. And she was using Paul Quinichette quite a bit at this time. They called Paul the vice president. You know, he played so much like Prez they called him the -- Prez was the president and that was the vice prez. And I did quite a few recordings with her, and I did quite a few recordings at that time with Billy Taylor. And -- because I worked with him quite a bit, and let's see--
Always a small group at that time.
